note: Ficohsa only, as before: Banco Atlántida's, BAC Honduras's and Banpaís's card tariffs weren't reached in this pass. Banco Ficohsa's card rates for November 2025 (the latest the bank's regulatory page gave), read in full: it prices its personal cards by tier (each tier sold in several programmes, La Colonia, Larach, Cash Back, disfruta+, Ficohsa+, LifeMiles, AAdvantage, which share the tier's terms): Clásica Internacional, Oro Internacional, Platinum, Signature and Infinite, each at 30.00% to 46.00% a year on dollar balances (up to 51.26% on lempira ones), written at the top with the bottom as the range's lowest, in dollars, the currency their memberships are priced in; the membership, billed monthly in lempiras from the next renewal, is 5 dollars a month for the Classic, 9.17 for the Oro, 13.00 for the Platinum, 15.75 for the Signature, 25 for the Infinite and 20.83 for the Infinite LifeMiles, Black and AAdvantage cards, written as their own card. Transactions abroad in a currency other than the US dollar carry 3%. The Clásica local is a lempira-only card whose membership is priced in dollars, and isn't written; nor are the business, corporate and PyMe cards, or the debt life insurance. No minimum payment, grace period or late fee is stated. Wave 4 (30 October 2026) added Banco de Occidente, one of the country's largest banks, whose card tariff its site links: its tariff of commissions in force from 1 July 2026, read in full (the card page's figures for the membership and the fees by card are set as an image and were read by eye; the rates are in its text). Its Visa Local card, in lempiras, at 48.00% a year, with a yearly membership of 100 lempiras; and its international cards (Visa Clásica, Oro, Platinum and Infinite, Mastercard Standard and Black), written in US dollars, the currency their memberships are priced in, as Ficohsa's are, at the 39.00% a year the tariff gives on foreign-currency balances (48.00% on lempira balances), with the yearly membership for the main card (25, 50, 75, 200, 20 and 150 dollars); a cash withdrawal at a counter of 5.00% (at an ATM in Honduras 5% up to 24 lempiras, not written); 3.00% on ATM withdrawals abroad, a cash charge abroad, not a charge on purchases, so no foreign transaction fee is written. The Visa Corporativa is a business card; the life insurance on the balance, the over-limit on request and the rehabilitation charges at 30, 60 and more days late (200, 400 and 600 lempiras) aren't written. Its monthly rate sheets (to September 2026) give the same 48.00% top in lempiras and 39.00% in dollars. No minimum payment or grace period is stated. Tried and not used: Banco Atlántida's card pages give no rates or fees, Davivienda Honduras's and the CNBS's home pages answered but weren't searched for card terms in this pass, Banpaís's redirected with no page, and BAC Credomatic's Honduras pages didn't answer. No minimum payment is published for Banco de Occidente's and Ficohsa's cards; tried (wave 5, 30 October 2026): every document this file cites, downloaded again on 30 October 2026 and searched for a minimum payment, states none for them; a search in Spanish returned press and bank reports of the 2017 and 2025 reforms of the Credit Card Law (requiring, as reported, that the minimum amortize part of the principal) but no text giving a share, and nothing from these banks; archive.org's availability API, asked for each of the 3 documents this file cites, names a snapshot for 1 of them, which can't be read, web.archive.org being refused from here.
